text: と　おもったのに　この　ざまだ…！

structure.en: that's what I thought, and yet

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに joins two parts with 'even though', with a feeling of disappointment. おもったのに = 'even though I thought so'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と points back at the words that were thought, here the line just before. と　おもった = 'that's what I thought'.
